name: SNEHA
letter_text:
Puttina Roju Subhakanshalu SNEHA!

I hope your day is filled with Makeup Kits, One bottle, and two Shots that make you smile after you are intoxicated.

Thank you for being such a Bish person. Ade ade BEST antunna, Sry typing Mistake! Nenu Neekosam Lopala chaala daachi Unnai photos, Kaani Baagodu ani lopale daachanu. 
Eyuuu inka roju motham enjoy enjoy. 

Itlu,
photo_captions: Aroju nunchi neeku makeup Paglu ane tag ki sanmanam chesina roju!!
Sneha yokka paalana IPE lo prarambam!!
Entha style ga unna sare, Food imp Bigilu!!
Evaru em anukunna sare ma Bish papa is THOPU!!
video_captions: Puvvulu yerukuntunna Sneha!!, plucking is my hobby antunna sneha!!
Wow kada, Indaaka photo lo kothilaga and ippudu kukka pilla laaga bale saripoyav!!!
Ni yavva thaggeledu antunna Sneha by that gesture!!
Samskaravanthmaiyna Family lo puttanu anni abbadalu aaduthunna Snehaa!! Pink handed ga dorikindi !
